metadata.question: Did the shoreline near Rasheed in Egypt retreat inland between July 25, 1984 and August 16, 2021?

data.raw_code: The user is asking about shoreline retreat near Rasheed, Egypt between 1984 and 2021. This requires: 1. Strategy: Use Landsat imagery to detect shoreline changes over time. Since the timeframe spans decades, I'll need to use different Landsat sensors: - 1984: Landsat 5 (launched 1984) - 2021: Landsat 8 (operational in 2021) 2. Location: Rasheed (Rosetta), Egypt is at approximately 31.4044°N, 30.4164°E. I'll create a coastal area polygon around this location. 3. Approach: Use NDWI (Normalized Difference Water Index) to detect water/land boundaries and compare positions between the two time periods. 4. Processing steps: - Define coastal area polygon - Get Landsat 5 (1984) and Landsat 8 (2021) collections - Calculate NDWI for water detection - Extract shoreline positions - Compare positions to detect retreat/advancement 5. Data quality checks: - Check collection sizes - Check valid pixel counts - Validate results (shoreline movement should be reasonable) Let me structure the code accordingly. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const rasheedCoast = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [30.35, 31.45], [30.35, 31.35], [30.50, 31.35], [30.50, 31.45] ]); const date1984 = {start: '1984-07-25', end: '1984-08-25'}; const date2021 = {start: '2021-08-01', end: '2021-09-01'}; // 2. Data Acquisition - Landsat 5 for 1984, Landsat 8 for 2021 let landsat5 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LT05/C02/T1_TOA') .filterBounds(rasheedCoast) .filterDate(date1984.start, date1984.end) .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUD_COVER', 20)); let landsat8 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_TOA') .filterBounds(rasheedCoast) .filterDate(date2021.start, date2021.end) .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUD_COVER', 20)); // Check collection sizes const size1984 = landsat5.size().getInfo(); const size2021 = landsat8.size().getInfo(); console.log(`1984 Images: ${size1984}, 2021 Images: ${size2021}`); if (size1984 === 0 || size2021 === 0) { console.log("C1"); return; } // 3. Processing - Get median composites and calculate NDWI const composite1984 = landsat5.median(); const composite2021 = landsat8.median(); // NDWI calculation: (Green - NIR) / (Green + NIR) const ndwi1984 = composite1984.normalizedDifference(['B2', 'B4']).rename('NDWI'); const ndwi2021 = composite2021.normalizedDifference(['B3', 'B5']).rename('NDWI'); // 4. Calculate water area statistics const water1984 = ndwi1984.gt(0); const water2021 = ndwi2021.gt(0); const stats1984 = water1984.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: rasheedCoast, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const stats2021 = water2021.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: rasheedCoast, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const waterPixels1984 = stats1984.NDWI || 0; const waterPixels2021 = stats2021.NDWI || 0; console.log(`Water pixels 1984: ${waterPixels1984}`); console.log(`Water pixels 2021: ${waterPixels2021}`); // Check for valid pixels if (waterPixels1984 === 0 || waterPixels2021 === 0) { console.log("C2"); return; } // 5. Analysis - Compare water areas to detect shoreline change // If water area decreased, shoreline retreated inland const waterChange = waterPixels2021 - waterPixels1984; console.log(`Water change: ${waterChange.toFixed(0)} pixels`); // Validate result if (waterChange === null || Math.abs(waterChange) > 100000) { console.log("C3"); return; } // If water area decreased (negative change), shoreline retreated inland if (waterChange < -100) { // Threshold to account for noise console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
